title: DOTr says fare hike remains last resort as LTFRB hearings continue

blocks.text: The Department of Transportation (DOTr) on Tuesday said fare hike petitions filed by public transport groups are still being heard by the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB), but emphasized that raising fares remains a last resort.
